title: Andersen's Fairy Tales
author: H. C. (Hans Christian) Andersen
description: "Andersen's Fairy Tales" by Hans Christian Andersen is a collection of enchanting stories written in the early to mid-19th century.
longDescription: The work showcases Andersen's imagination and moral reflections manifested through his whimsical and often poignant tales, featuring memorable characters and intricate plots.

authorInfo.bio: H. C. (Hans Christian) Andersen (1805–1875) wrote Andersen's Fairy Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
